def find_diamonds(g):
    g = np.array(g); R,C = g.shape
    dia = []
    for r in range(1,R-1):
        for c in range(1,C-1):
            n4 = [g[r-1,c],g[r+1,c],g[r,c-1],g[r,c+1]]
            if all(x==3 for x in n4) and g[r,c]!=3:
                dia.append((r,c,int(g[r,c])))
    return dia

def simulate(g, tie='last'):
    g = np.array(g); R,C = g.shape
    dia = find_diamonds(g)
    e = [d for d in dia if d[2]==0][0]
    col_d = [d for d in dia if d[2]!=0]
    # movement
    newpos = []
    for (r,c,v) in col_d:
        dr,dc = e[0]-r, e[1]-c
        conflict = any(x==r for x in [e[0]]) or any(x==c for x in [e[1]])
        if conflict:
            move = (abs(dr)<=abs(dc) and (r+(1 if dr>0 else -1), c)) or ((r, c+(1 if dc>0 else -1)))
        else:
            move = (r, c+(1 if dc>0 else -1)) if abs(dc)>abs(dr) else (r,c)
        newpos.append((move[0],move[1],v))
    # erase all diamond cells
    out = g.copy()
    for (r,c,v) in col_d:
        for (rr,cc) in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1),(r,c)]:
            out[rr,cc]=0
    for (r,c,v) in [e]:
        for (rr,cc) in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1),(r,c)]:
            out[rr,cc]=0
    # draw new rings+centers
    for (r,c,v) in newpos:
        for (rr,cc) in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)]:
            out[rr,cc]=3
        out[r,c]=v
    er = e[0]; ec = e[1]
    # Phase H: horizontals, paint only 0-cells, stop at 3
    for (r,c,v) in newpos:
        for cc in range(c-1,-1,-1):
            if out[r,cc]==3: break
            if out[r,cc]==0: out[r,cc]=v
        for cc in range(c+1,C):
            if out[r,cc]==3: break
            if out[r,cc]==0: out[r,cc]=v
    for cc in range(ec-1,-1,-1):
        if out[er,cc]==3: break
        if out[er,cc]==0: out[er,cc]=0
    for cc in range(ec+1,C):
        if out[er,cc]==3: break
        if out[er,cc]==0: out[er,cc]=0
    # Phase V: verticals; colored: stop at 3, overwrite? param; white: erase (paint 0) unless 3
    vcols = {}
    for (r,c,v) in newpos:
        vcols.setdefault(c,[]).append((r,v))
    wnodes = vcols.get(ec,[]) + [(er,0)]
    for c, lst in sorted(vcols.items()):
        lst = sorted(lst)
        if c==ec:
            # white erases whole column except 3
            for rr in range(R):
                if out[rr,c]!=3: out[rr,c]=0
            continue
        painted = {}
        for idx,(r,v) in enumerate(lst):
            for rr in range(r-1,-1,-1):
                if out[rr,c]==3: break
                painted[rr]=v
            for rr in range(r+1,R):
                if out[rr,c]==3: break
                painted[rr]=v
        for rr,vv in painted.items():
            out[rr,c]=vv
    # white vertical erase last? or first? try last here
    for rr in range(R):
        if out[rr,ec]!=3: out[rr,ec]=0
    return out

for (name, gi, go) in [('demo1', I, O), ('demo2', N, N2), ('demo4', D4I, D4O)]:

def simulate2(g, tie_cell=1):

    g = np.array(g); R,C = g.shape
    dia = find_diamonds(g)
    whites = [d for d in dia if d[2]==0]
    e = whites[0]
    col_d = [d for d in dia if d[2]!=0]
    newpos = []
    for (r,c,v) in col_d:
        dr,dc = e[0]-r, e[1]-c
        conflict = (e[0]==r) or (e[1]==c)
        if conflict:
            if abs(dr)>=abs(dc): move=(r+(1 if dr>0 else -1), c)
            else: move=(r, c+(1 if dc>0 else -1))
        else:
            move = (r, c+(1 if dc>0 else -1)) if abs(dc)>abs(dr) else (r,c)
        newpos.append((move[0],move[1],v))
    out = g.copy()
    cells = lambda r,c: [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1),(r,c)]
    for (r,c,v) in col_d + whites:
        for (rr,cc) in cells(r,c): out[rr,cc]=0
    allpos = newpos + whites
    for (r,c,v) in allpos:
        for (rr,cc) in cells(r,c)[:4]: out[rr,cc]=3
        out[r,c]=v
